byProperty.product: product identity-gradient tile with the symbol in that gradient's foreground contract (symbol-white on onDeep, symbol-color on onLight) — open until each product's gradient is approved

approach.repetitionAuthority: OWNER-MOTION-01 (2026-09-11) — replaces once-only; cycle length unchanged; owner confirmed the reveal-on-re-entry interpretation on 2026-09-15

ctaDiscoveryCue.repetitionNote: once per page load (owner confirmed 2026-09-15): the cue is motion over the primary action, which MOTION-04 / MOTIF-04 prohibit as ambience

identityFileDeltasAccepted.disposition: accepted_and_recorded; official PNG files remain the identity of record

observer.onEnter: play immediately then repeat every cycle
observer.onExit: clear the timer and hold the final state

identity.technique: repeated finite plays; animation-iteration-count: infinite is forbidden
identity.pageControl: one page-level pause/resume control (MotionController); pause shows the complete final state
prohibited: motion over the first answer, the primary proof or the primary action
motifs in navigation, favicon or OG images
scope: document_flow, pdf_fixed and deck_presentation only when rendered in a browser

full.inkNote: runtime renditions keep the governed light-reference ink: <lm-motif ink="blue">

quiet.inkNote: runtime default quiet ink (energy.sky); no other ink value has a governed file

carrierPolicy.declaration: data-host-surface on every MotifFrame and static motif placement: a carrier id (themed ids resolve per theme), a theme-fixed form <id>@light|@dark, or an invariant id
carrierPolicy.themeSwap: data-variant is the light-theme variant; data-variant-dark="quiet" switches a full frame on a themed surface to quiet in the dark theme — the only swap the measured policy admits
neverOnTheAsset: plate or tile under the mark

productOverlays.principle: product animated identities are separately registered overlays with their own final fallback, duration, minimum size and host surface; families are never mixed in one lockup; navigation, favicon and OG images use official identity files

ownerApproval.scope: ijji.logo-sting.r3, ijji.four-beat.selected-3.r3, CityChat conversation set (current montri-th/motif bytes), CityMETER and CityWiki stings pre-approved pending Studio 1.4 production

repetition.appliesTo: decorative and identity motion (motif runtime, approach reveal on re-entry); not the CTA discovery cue

constraints.forbiddenHueWindows: analyticalScalePolicy.bannedHue (DATAVIZ-04: OKLCh windows, purged-value proximity, pink ruling)

recognisers.panel: brand.blue or one declared atmosphere recipe
